headline: COP31 spills into the weekend with fossil fuels cut from the draft deal, the Trump–Xi–Putin summit ends without breakthroughs, and Ghana gets new vaccine and DNA labs.

items.title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen but agree little
items.summary: The three leaders held a roughly 90-minute meeting on the sidelines of APEC in China, the first such three-way talks. Their joint statement backs more oil and gas output and says a nuclear war cannot be won, but analysts saw no breakthroughs; Putin said Russia would not negotiate on Ukraine after the strike on the Kerch bridge.
items.why: A joint pledge to pump more oil and gas pulls against the climate goals that drive carbon-credit demand.
items.videoQuery: Trump Xi Putin Shenzhen trilateral meeting

items.title: Four takeaways from the three-way summit
items.summary: Analysts quoted by RFE/RL called it historic but thin on substance: the statement challenges the International Criminal Court, gives only a vague pledge on nuclear talks and does not mention the Iran war. China described the meeting as constructive, while some analysts saw Putin as the main winner.

items.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea reported to mass troops on their border
items.summary: Conflict monitors cited by Reuters say both armies have built up forces and exchanged fire near Badme in mid-November, though Reuters could not confirm the clashes. Eritrea dismissed Ethiopian claims as propaganda; Ethiopia did not comment.

items.title: COP31 runs into overtime after fossil fuels vanish from the draft
items.summary: Talks in Antalya missed their Friday finish as a shorter draft dropped every mention of oil, gas and coal and the $120bn adaptation-finance goal. The EU warned of a 'fossil summit', Panama threatened to object to any deal without fossil-fuel language, and the COP presidency said good progress had been made; a new draft was expected Saturday.
items.why: Ghana's environment minister is in the room; the final text on finance and markets shapes demand for Ghana's Article 6 credits.
items.videoQuery: COP31 Antalya final day fossil fuels

items.title: A coalition demands a stronger deal on the final day
items.summary: France and Panama led countries including Côte d'Ivoire and Vanuatu in calling the draft not good enough, listing six priorities from a fossil-fuel transition to clean electrification and methane. The UN Secretary-General urged tripling adaptation finance by 2035 and a windfall tax on fossil-fuel firms.

items.title: Electrification becomes COP31's headline pledge
items.summary: Outside the negotiated text, a voluntary pledge aims to raise electricity's share of final energy to 35% by 2035, and philanthropies pledged over $480m for methane and other super-pollutants. Host Turkey says it has signed deals and plans worth over $26bn during the summit, including a preliminary $15bn renewables deal with China.
items.why: Clean electrification and clean heat are the space Carbon Clarity's ovens sit in.

items.title: Mahama opens DNA and vaccine labs at Noguchi
items.summary: The President commissioned new human DNA testing facilities and a vaccine development laboratory at the Noguchi Memorial Institute in Accra. The institute's director said they will cut reliance on foreign labs and improve readiness for health emergencies.

items.title: Senegal's ruling party expels the President
items.summary: Pastef expelled President Bassirou Diomaye Faye and 31 others it called inactive members, deepening his split with Speaker Ousmane Sonko. Pastef holds 130 of 165 seats and Faye's new party has none, a standoff that could hold up the 2027 budget and IMF funding.

items.title: All 36 Nigerian states back state police
items.summary: Every state assembly approved a constitutional amendment allowing state police forces; it now needs President Tinubu's assent and further laws. Supporters see it as a response to insecurity, while critics fear governors could misuse the forces.

items.title: AI jitters keep shaking Wall Street
items.summary: US stocks fell again on 17 November, with the Dow down about 850 points, as worries about AI valuations, high interest rates and Nvidia's leadership change weighed on markets. Nvidia's former CFO is interim CEO after Jensen Huang stepped down earlier in the month.

items.title: Nigeria turns fuel exporter, led by Dangote
items.summary: UK data show refined-oil imports from Nigeria more than doubled in the year to June, and Nigeria became a net petrol exporter in April for the first time in decades. Much of the supply comes from the Dangote Refinery.
items.why: Shows how a big African industrial bet can flip a trade balance: a useful case for sales and study essays.

items.title: Mo Abudu launches a $50m African film fund
items.summary: The Nigerian media entrepreneur's fund aims to finance about 35 African films over eight years, with first investments planned for early 2027.

items.title: Compound burns fat without losing muscle in mice
items.summary: A UC Berkeley team found an experimental compound raised energy use by up to 18% in mice, cutting fat while sparing muscle and working better alongside drugs like semaglutide. It has only been tested in animals so far.

items.title: Fungal toxins found in all 212 plant-based foods tested
items.summary: Researchers detected at least one mycotoxin in every UK vegan and vegetarian product they tested, though all levels were below EU guidelines. They say consumers need not worry but want monitoring rules for new plant-based foods.
items.why: Mycotoxins are a known risk in stored and smoked foods too; food-safety evidence matters for smoked-fish buyers.

items.title: Africa CDC says DR Congo's Ebola outbreak is still not under control
items.summary: Six months after it was declared, the outbreak has passed 11,200 infections and 5,500 deaths, with most new cases outside known contact lists. Africa CDC wants pledged funds released faster.

good.title: Ghana named among BBC Travel's best places to visit in 2027
good.summary: Ghana and Madagascar are the only African picks, with Ghana's 70th independence anniversary, Panafest and Cape Coast highlighted.
good.videoQuery: Ghana BBC best places to travel 2027

good.title: Ghana's amputee team reaches the World Cup semi-finals
good.summary: The Black Challenge beat the USA and Egypt to set up a semi-final against Turkey at the Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico.

good.title: Africa's disaster early warnings now match the Americas
good.summary: A UN and WMO report says Africa improved its early-warning systems more than any region; 70% of countries now report multi-hazard systems.

good.title: South Africa registers 2GW of new solar in one quarter
good.summary: The energy regulator registered 139 new solar facilities totalling about 2,045MW in the quarter to September, spread across all nine provinces.

good.title: Benin gets financing for a 62MW solar portfolio
good.summary: IFC and Proparco are lending €30m to Axian Energy for four plants that Proparco says equal almost a tenth of Benin's installed capacity.

quiz.q: What share of final energy does COP31's voluntary electrification pledge target by 2035?
quiz.why: The '35 by 35' pledge aims for electricity to supply 35% of final energy by 2035.

quiz.q: Which institute in Accra got new DNA and vaccine laboratories this week?
quiz.why: President Mahama commissioned the labs at the Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research.

quiz.q: Where did Trump, Xi and Putin hold their three-way meeting?
quiz.why: They met in Shenzhen on the sidelines of the APEC summit hosted by China.

future.title: Clean cooking financed by carbon credits
future.why: New government policies across Africa have helped secure about $900 million in new clean-cooking finance, with carbon credits as the main engine. The catch: it only lasts if buyers trust the credits.
future.fit: This is Carbon Clarity's core. The winners will be projects with measured, audit-ready data.
future.step: This month: map which Gold Standard metered-method requirements your pilot data already meets.

future.title: Digital MRV and high-integrity credit data
future.why: Credit buyers increasingly pay only for credits they can verify. Sensor-based monitoring and clean data trails are becoming the difference between credits that sell and credits that don't.
future.fit: Your Data Vault idea could become a service for other cookstove and agriculture projects in Ghana.
future.step: Write a one-page description of the Data Vault as a service: who pays, what it proves.

future.title: Clean heat for small industries
future.why: RMI lists clean industrial heat among Africa's six emerging climate-tech opportunities. Fish smoking is exactly this: small-scale process heat.
future.fit: Improved ovens for fish processors are a clean-heat business with income for women, not just a stove programme.
future.step: Estimate the market: how many processors in Greater Accra and coastal Ghana, and how much wood they burn.

future.title: Carbon removal from biomass: biochar
future.why: RMI also highlights carbon dioxide removal that uses Africa's biomass and soils, a market where removal credits sell for far more than avoidance credits.
future.fit: Waste biomass from smoking (husks, offcuts) could be turned into biochar: a second revenue stream.
future.step: Read one biochar removal methodology and list what you'd need to measure.

future.title: Energy-led climate tech is where African investment goes
future.why: Africa's climate-tech startups raised $6.35bn from 2016 to 2025, now the continent's biggest venture sector, with energy taking about 65% of the money.
future.fit: Pitch Carbon Clarity as energy plus livelihoods: efficient heat, solar drying or cold storage for fish.
future.step: Add one slide to your pitch: 'Why energy investors should care about fish smoking'.

future.title: Article 6 advisory for Ghanaian projects
future.why: Ghana is one of the first countries trading credits between governments under Article 6. Developers need people who understand authorisation, corresponding adjustments and the Carbon Market Office process.
future.fit: Your Ghana carbon market research makes you one of those people: it can become consulting work or a job.
future.step: Turn your Step 3 agreement table into a two-page brief you can share on LinkedIn.
